variants.prompt: the wind-up pose: both pairs of wings raised high and spread fully open so the two yellow eye-spots face the viewer, antennae raised, body hanging below. No glow, no dust.
the attack pose: it dives forward to the right, wings swept back behind the body, the head and legs reaching forward and down.

its second form: the wings held wider and a little raised, the wing edges frayed and torn, the yellow eye-spots larger with a red centre ring, the white chest fur bristling. No dust, no glow, no particles.
